name: Glowing 3D Card
description: Image card that tilts in 3D toward the cursor and scales up on hover while a radial glow follows the pointer across its surface.
contents: Single card with background image and a text label slot in the top right
behavior: Card rotates and scales in 3D based on pointer position relative to its center
Radial light glow follows the pointer
Card eases back to rest and shadow deepens on hover
editableByProps: Card size, corner radius, background image and label content
Tilt sensitivity, hover scale, glow color and intensity, text color

needsCodeEdit.where: shadow-[0_1px_5px_rgba(0,0,0,0.6)] class on the card div
radial-gradient(circle at 50% -20% fallback in the glow overlay div

Tilt is driven by mouse events only, so touch devices see the static card
